author: ViceTechnicolour
body:
Hello friends,

I had an idea that I threw around in the map developer chat, and I wanted to post it here to gather opinions on something: readding the Nebula shop, but in a balanced way that is entirely dependent on the rotation. If enough support is gathered, I will petition to get it added on Future or Dev or another server where the concept can be publicly tested and evaluated.

What is my idea?
My idea is to add a new currency that is useful.
  - The currency would be emeralds, known as "Avicoins"
  - You would get 1 for every kill, and 5 for every objective
The currency would be able to be spent.
  - Every spawn will have an enderchest you can store them in
  - The currency will transfer throughout maps as you store them
  - You can build up the currency throughout until restart
  - You will keep your emeralds even if you die using a keep-item feature
  - The emeralds will not transfer automatically, again store them in a chest
You will be able to spend them on villagers for many unique strategic items.

However, I'd like to see what items you believe should be added.

So far, the following items are planned to be available:
- 4 Avicoins » Instant Healing II
- 8 Avicoins » 16 Snowballs
- 8 Avicoins » 16 Logs (will encourage defense, not available on TDM or Clay Wars)
- 16 Avicoins » 4 Grenades (eggs that explode on impact, will be added to all maps)
- 24 Avicoins » Spanky Spade (Diamond Shovel, KB 1) (not available on Luar/Quintus)
- 24 Avicoins » 2 Bombs (TNT that will actually do block damage to environment, not on Frostbite/Zalidor Snow)
- 48 Avicoins » ? (max coin reward amount)
